articles.summary: On 6 November 2025, the French Competition Authority (ADLC) issued a landmark decision on digital platforms against Doctolib for abusing its dominant position in the markets for online medical appointment booking services and remote medical consultation solutions, as well as for engaging in a “killer acquisition” (below the threshold) of its main competitor, MonDocteur.
